chunks.title: NVDA demand remains strong
chunks.text: AI chip demand remains strong and management highlighted healthy enterprise orders.

chunks.title: Investors watch valuation risk
chunks.text: Some analysts warned that valuation risk could limit upside after the recent surge.

chunks.title: Cloud growth improves
chunks.text: Cloud growth remained strong and enterprise demand improved across major customer segments.

chunks.title: Investors monitor AI spending
chunks.text: Investors said sustained AI spending will be watched closely, but management commentary stayed upbeat.

chunks.title: Delivery concerns rise
chunks.text: Analysts cited weak delivery expectations and margin risk heading into the next update.

chunks.title: Price cuts remain in focus
chunks.text: Further price cuts could pressure profitability even if unit demand stabilizes.
